title: Document how to run the local check
reason: The command and expected report fields are known; document them without adding integrations.
proposedAction: After human approval, add the local check command and expected output to the project docs.

title: Change the default issue queue location
reason: A human must decide whether changing the input path is acceptable before any code or issue data changes.
proposedAction: Ask a human to approve or reject moving the default queue from data/issue-events.jsonl to issues.jsonl.

title: Define when an issue is stale
reason: No age threshold or reference timestamp has been specified. Ask which threshold and timestamp to use.
proposedAction: Ask a human for the staleness threshold and timestamp source before proposing an implementation.
